description: Image Description: The image shows a rectangular blue traffic sign mounted on the side of a building, affixed with metal brackets. The sign has a white border and features several white pictograms on a blue background. On the left side of the sign, there is a stylized figure of an adult walking, depicted in a simplified human form. To the right of the walking figure, there is a small car icon, indicating vehicular traffic. Below the car, a curved line leads to a house symbol
